item.title: Minnesota's Moose Population Climbs While Challenges Remain for Their Future
item.description: In a hopeful turn, Minnesota's moose population has increased to 4,470, up from 4,075 last year, but the DNR warns of ongoing vulnerabilities.

item.title: Sorry Parents, You May Want to Rethink NeeDoh Toys For Air Travel
item.description: NeeDoh toys, beloved by kids for their squishy appeal, are causing travel headaches.

item.title: Meet Lola At TriCounty Humane Society In St. Cloud, Ready For A Loving Home
item.description: Meet Lola, a playful pit bull mix at TriCounty Humane Society, ready to find her forever home. She loves playtime and needs an active family to match her energy.

item.title: Sauk Rapids-Rice Anticipates Early Spring Games Starting Next Tuesday Against Bemidji
item.description: Sauk Rapids-Rice is gearing up for an early outdoor sports season, with softball set to play Bemidji next Tuesday and exciting new facilities on the horizon.

item.title: Driving With Dogs In Minnesota: What To Know For Safe Travels
item.description: As the sun shines on Minnesota, many are driving with their dogs, but remember: a lap dog can lead to distractions and potential legal issues.

item.title: St. Cloud Compost Site Opens April 6, Yard Waste Collection Starts This Spring
item.description: St. Cloud's compost site opens April 6, accepting yard waste in compostable bags. Remember to bundle branches separately. Fees have increased due to ash tree debris disposal costs.

item.title: St. Cloud Woman Charged After Scissors Attack on Group Home Worker
item.description: A St. Cloud woman faces felony charges after allegedly attacking a group home worker with scissors, leaving the victim with multiple stab wounds and requiring stitches for her injuries.

item.title: Huskies Hold Off Bulldogs For A Nail-biting 9-8 Win In Second Game
item.description: The SCSU Huskies crushed the UMD Bulldogs 18-0, showcasing power with 14 hits, including three homers, while freshman pitcher Conner Larson struck out six in a dazzling performance.

item.title: Easter Fun Kicks Off With Egg Hunts And The Easter Bunny In Paynesville And St. Cloud
item.description: The Easter Weekender in Minnesota features everything from egg hunts and comedy shows to a boxing championship, making it a lively time for families and individuals alike.

item.title: Treasure Hunting At Central Minnesota Flea Markets Brings Back Childhood Dreams
item.description: From retro games to local treasures, Central Minnesota’s flea markets offer a nostalgic hunt for unique finds, perfect for those weekend explorers looking for something special.

item.title: Minnesota Zoo's 'Farm Babies' Event Brings Spring Joy With Piglets And Chicks, April 26-May 3
item.description: Spring in Minnesota blooms with the Minneapolis-St. Paul International Film Festival and Art in Bloom, plus family-friendly fun like the Minnesota Zoo's 'Farm Babies' and the 100 Mile Garage Sale.

item.title: Melrose Secures $670,000 For Downtown Redevelopment And Infrastructure Upgrades
item.description: Melrose is set to revamp its downtown with $670,000 for demolishing old buildings and building a new warehouse.

item.title: Target Field Rolls Out Gluten-free Options and More For The New Season
item.description: New gluten-free stands and unique treats like chocolate fish on a stick are now available at Target Field, catering to fans with dietary restrictions this season.

item.title: Exploring The Impacts Of Declawing On Cats And Better Care Options
item.description: A look at the challenges of cat ownership reveals how declawing, once common, can lead to serious long-term issues for our feline friends. Alternatives are available and worth considering.

item.title: Rising Gas Prices In Minnesota Prompt Discussions On Tax Suspension
item.description: Minnesota is grappling with rising gas prices, sparking talks about suspending the gas tax to help families, but concerns about budget deficits and funding for roads loom large.
